DEFINE

		TREATAS({"No"}, 'Calendar WBR'[is_current_week])

		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('WBR TA Actual'[Client])),
			NOT('WBR TA Actual'[Client] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({FALSE,
			BLANK()}, 'candidate'[is_candidate_archived])

		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('job'[test])),
			NOT('job'[test] IN {TRUE})

		__DS0FilterTable,

						"Wolt North, Baltics & Benelux",

						"Wolt Volume",
						"Wolt Expansion",
						"AVIV"}

				NOT('WBR TA Actual'[Client] IN {BLANK()})

		TREATAS({"No"}, 'Calendar WBR'[is_current_week])

			"SumHires", CALCULATE(SUM('WBR TA Actual'[Hires])),

			"SumJob_60_days", CALCULATE(SUM('WBR TA Actual'[Job 60 days])),
			"Last_12w_ATS", 'WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w ATS],
			"Last_12w_Actual_Screens", 'WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w Actual Screens],
			"Last_12w_Time_to_Fill", 'WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w Time to Fill],
			"Last_12w___Actual_Screens_to_Hires", 'WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w % Actual Screens to Hires],
			"v__Actual_Screens_to_ATS", 'WBR TA Actual'[% Actual Screens to ATS],
			"Contacted_color", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Contacted color]),
			"Screens_color", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Screens color]),
			"Moved_to_ATS_color", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Moved to ATS color]),
			"Last_12w_Wolt__", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w Wolt %]),
			"MinMissing_comment", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('WBR TA Actual'[Missing comment]))),
			"Last_12w_ATS___target", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w ATS % target]),
			"Last_12w_Actual_Screens___Target", IGNORE('WBR TA Actual'[Last 12w Actual Screens % Target])
		)

		TOPN(501, __DS0Core, 'WBR TA Actual'[Client], 1, 'WBR TA Actual'[who_event_created_for], 1)

	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

	'WBR TA Actual'[Client], 'WBR TA Actual'[who_event_created_for]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Same"}, 'event'[Not Official Sourcer WBR])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({FALSE,
			BLANK()}, 'job'[is_job_archived])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Current_TS'[TS])),
			NOT('Current_TS'[TS] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		TREATAS({BLANK()}, 'job'[Temp hide from WBR TS])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable5 = 
		TREATAS({"No"}, 'Calendar WBR'[is_current_week])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable6 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('WBR TA Actual'[Client])),
			NOT('WBR TA Actual'[Client] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable7 = 
		TREATAS({FALSE,
			BLANK()}, 'candidate'[is_candidate_archived])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable8 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('job'[test])),
			NOT('job'[test] IN {TRUE})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'event'[who_created_event_first],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4,
			__DS0FilterTable5,
			__DS0FilterTable6,
			__DS0FilterTable7,
			__DS0FilterTable8,
			"v__Screens_Actual_to_ATS", 'Metrics'[% Screens Actual to ATS],
			"v__Screens_to_Actual_Screen", 'Metrics'[% Screens to Actual Screen],
			"v__Contacted_to_Positive_Response", 'Metrics'[% Contacted to Positive Response],
			"DistinctCountjob_id", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('job'[job_id])),
			"v__candidates___positive_response", 'Metrics'[# candidates - positive response],
			"v__candidates___actual_screen__actual_screen_date_", 'Metrics'[# candidates - actual screen (actual screen date)],
			"v__candidates___move_to_ATS__moved_date_", 'Metrics'[# candidates - move to ATS (moved date)]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(501, __DS0Core, 'event'[who_created_event_first], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'event'[who_created_event_first]
